title: TemplateQuestionUpdated.v1
description: Emitted when a template question's content or settings are changed. Only modified fields are included in `changes`.

templateId.description: ID of the template draft this item belongs to.
templateId.markdownDescription: ID of the template draft this item belongs to.

pillarSlug.description: URL-safe slug of the pillar this item belongs to.
pillarSlug.markdownDescription: URL-safe slug of the pillar this item belongs to.

questionId.description: Unique identifier of the updated question.
questionId.markdownDescription: Unique identifier of the updated question.

changes.description: Map of field names to their new values. Only changed fields are included.
changes.markdownDescription: Map of field names to their new values. Only changed fields are included.
